A Molecular Fabric That Weaves Four Nets Together | Nature

A two-dimensional reticular triaxial molecularly woven fabric
First author: Wang, Mengbin
Last author: Huang, Feihe
Co-first authors: Mengbin Wang, Shuai Fang, Xuedong Xiao, Zhewen Guo, Tianyu Shan
Journal: Nature
Published online: 2026-11-04
DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11218-8

Researchers have created a molecular fabric in which four honeycomb-like networks interweave along three directions, giving individual layers a repeating handed structure. Crystal measurements and laboratory separation tests reveal an elastic, porous material that preferentially captures aromatic molecules, opening possibilities for new molecular filters and adaptable materials.
